reserveReview.rationale: At BSC block 130522586, hash 0x12803ae00561efbe0d642761acf134cbde640d70cc1dc6f8a5bf4b8d1f9d5e02, timestamped 2026-10-29T18:39:15Z, the exact wrapper 0x0e8fb2e774b827711e0f86069931c1321113238e reports sUSDC() = 0xc603ef9cab5e4131c52f6b8bcf06cc0568c32a24 and spusd() = 0x40ff3dea2eec93a7b71879874dc4407918da77a6, the cataloged SPUSD token. Same-block SPUSD totalSupply is 51856398099092123719581073 base units at 18 decimals (51,856,398.099092123719581073 tokens), while sUSDC.balanceOf(wrapper) is 71322444284218345501586244 base units at 18 decimals (71,322,444.284218345501586244). Both nonproxy SPUSD and wrapper runtimes exactly match Sourcify's verified onchainBytecode as previously reviewed. The wrapper's two mint paths transfer the same amount of the single immutable sUSDC receipt before minting SPUSD; its ordinary unwrap returns that receipt, not USDC. The 100% row therefore records the observed immediate receipt backing claim, without valuing excess receipts as additional collateral or treating cumulative USDC deposit counters as assets. Token role administrators can authorize additional minting; no immutable collateral-gating finding is made. All underlying strategy/treasury and BSC-USDC representation look-through remains an explicit 100% insufficient-evidence remainder. No native Circle USDC identity, Venus allocation percentage, current full underlying portfolio, or canonical escrow is asserted.
